name: DD File Overwrite
description: Detects potential overwriting and deletion of a file using dd, a common anti-forensic data-destruction technique. Adapted from SigmaHQ. Source: detections/rules/proc_creation_lnx_dd_file_overwrite.yml, hand-converted from Sigma.
query: any where process.executable like~ "*/dd" and process.title like~ "*of=*" and process.title like~ ("*if=/dev/zero*", "*if=/dev/null*")
false_positives: Any user deleting files that way
author: Sentinel
